title: Towards Practical Compression of 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality novel-view synthesis but requires substantial storage. Existing compression methods often rely on spatial context modeling over irregular 3D representations, increasing the complexity of training and coding. Meanwhile, floating-point context inference can introduce numerical inconsistencies across platforms, causing entropy-decoding failures. To address these practical challenges, we propose COSA-GS, which constructs context without spatial aggregation through anchor-wise causal factorization. Specifically, we use geometry context derived from each anchor's coordinates to model a compact learnable anchor latent. The anchor latent is then fused with the geometry context to form an anchor context for attribute coding. The resulting context model features a simple architecture composed solely of linear transformations and activations. We train COSA-GS using rate--distortion optimization with adaptive Gaussian pruning. Further, we develop quantization-aware training and integer inference for the context model to achieve bit-exact consistency of entropy-decoded symbols across platforms. Experiments demonstrate that COSA-GS achieves state-of-the-art compression performance while retaining fast and consistent cross-platform decoding, providing a simple yet effective framework for practical 3DGS compression. Code is available at https://github.com/pengpeng-yu/COSA-GS.
tldr: 提出 COSA-GS，通过锚点因果分解构建上下文，实现跨平台一致的高效 3DGS 压缩。
motivation: 3DGS 虽能高质量合成新视角，但存储开销大；现有压缩方法常依赖不规则 3D 表示上的空间上下文建模，增加训练与编码复杂度。同时，浮点上下文推断可能造成跨平台数值不一致，进而导致熵解码失败。
method: COSA-GS 不进行空间聚合，而是通过 anchor-wise causal factorization 构建上下文：利用每个 anchor 坐标的几何上下文建模紧凑可学习 anchor latent，并与几何上下文融合形成 anchor context 用于属性编码，模型仅由线性变换和激活组成。训练采用率失真优化与自适应高斯剪枝，并引入量化感知训练和整数推断，使上下文模型实现跨平台 bit-exact 的熵解码符号一致性。
result: 实验表明 COSA-GS 在保持快速且一致的跨平台解码的同时，达到 state-of-the-art 压缩性能；摘要未提供具体压缩率、PSNR 等量化指标。
conclusion: 该工作为实际 3DGS 压缩提供了一个简单有效的框架，兼顾高压缩性能与跨平台部署一致性，代码已开源。

title: Training-Free Hold-Usage Detection in Sport Climbing with Foundation Pose Models
abstract: Detecting which holds a climber uses, and when, underpins automated scoring, movement analysis, and assistive systems for sport climbing. Existing approaches train task-specific models or repurpose 2D pose estimators whose hand keypoint sits at the wrist and foot keypoint at the ankle i.e. offset from the fingertips and toes that actually contact the holds, and whose hands are occluded in roughly half of all frames. We show that a frozen, off-the-shelf pose foundation model is sufficient: using the fingertip and toe keypoints of Sapiens, a per-frame proximity test against the annotated holds, per-limb mutual exclusion, and a short temporal-persistence rule, we detect hold usage without any climbing-specific training. On the The Way Up dataset (22 videos, 10 athletes, two routes), our method reaches an event F_1 of 90.2% on a held-out split (89.8% under leave-one-participant-out cross-validation) and 79.9% over all 22 videos at any temporal overlap, and performs best on footholds (F_1,89.8% overall, 96.6% held-out). Under an identical protocol it exceeds our reproductions of the YOLOv8-pose and ViTPose pipelines at every temporal threshold, with the margin widening under strict timing. An ablation shows that two intuitively helpful additions---dense foundation-feature change gating and body-part segmentation---both hurt, arguing that a minimal, keypoint-only design is the right one for this task. Finally, standard coaching statistics computed from our automatic predictions track ground truth closely (Pearson r=1.00 for climb time, 0.94 for pace), turning ordinary single-camera video into reliable performance metrics with no instrumentation.
tldr: 基于冻结Sapiens指尖/脚尖关键点与岩点邻近匹配，无需训练即可检测攀岩抓握使用。
motivation: 现有方法要么训练任务专用模型，要么复用2D姿态估计器，但后者手部关键点在手腕、脚部关键点在脚踝，偏离实际接触岩点的指尖和脚尖，且手部约半数帧被遮挡。
method: 冻结现成姿态基础模型Sapiens，提取指尖和脚尖关键点，对标注岩点进行逐帧邻近测试，并加入同肢互斥与短时时间持续性规则，无需攀岩特定训练；消融表明密集基础特征变化门控和身体部位分割都会损害性能，支持仅关键点的最小设计。
result: 在The Way Up数据集（22个视频、10名运动员、两条路线）上，事件F1在留出划分达90.2%（留一参与者交叉验证89.8%），全部22个视频任意时间重叠下为79.9%；脚点表现最佳（总体89.8%，留出96.6%）。相同协议下在每个时间阈值均优于复现的YOLOv8-pose和ViTPose流程，严格时间要求下优势更大；自动预测得到的攀爬时间与步速分别与真值Pearson r=1.00和0.94。
conclusion: 无需仪器，仅用普通单相机视频即可获得可靠的攀岩表现指标。最小化关键点设计适合该任务，可支撑自动评分、动作分析和辅助系统。

title: OceanXL: Large-scale Underwater 3D Gaussian Splatting via Block Partitioning and Adaptive Pruning
abstract: Underwater 3D reconstruction is critical for marine exploration, ecological monitoring, and subsea infrastructure inspection, yet remains challenging at large scale due to light attenuation, scattering, and limited capture coverage. While 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-quality real-time rendering, its application to large underwater scenes is constrained by high memory consumption and inefficient optimization over extensive areas. We propose OceanXL, a fast and scalable 3DGS-based framework for large-scale underwater reconstruction. OceanXL adopts a divide-and-conquer strategy, partitioning scenes into spatially coherent blocks to enable efficient optimization while preserving global geometric consistency. We further introduce an adaptive pruning scheme tailored to underwater conditions that removes redundant primitives, producing compact representations without sacrificing visual fidelity. Together, these components improve training efficiency and rendering performance for large scenes. We also introduce a large-scale underwater dataset covering diverse marine environments. Experiments on five large-scale scenes demonstrate favorable scalability, compactness, and efficiency--quality trade-offs over large-scene baselines. Controlled comparisons on the small-scale SeaThru-NeRF dataset further show competitive reconstruction quality with substantially smaller model sizes than underwater-specific methods.
tldr: OceanXL 通过分块与自适应剪枝实现大规模水下3DGS重建，兼顾效率与紧凑性。
motivation: 水下三维重建对海洋探索、生态监测和海底基础设施巡检至关重要，但大规模场景受光衰减、散射和采集覆盖有限等挑战制约。3DGS虽能实现高质量实时渲染，却因内存消耗高和广阔区域优化低效而难以直接应用于大型水下场景。
method: OceanXL采用分治策略，将场景划分为空间连贯的块以高效优化，同时保持全局几何一致性。该方法还引入面向水下条件的自适应剪枝方案，去除冗余高斯基元，在不牺牲视觉保真度的情况下生成紧凑表示，并构建了一个覆盖多样海洋环境的大规模水下数据集。
result: 在五个大规模场景上的实验表明，OceanXL相比大场景基线在可扩展性、紧凑性及效率与质量权衡上表现更优。在SeaThru-NeRF小规模数据集上的受控对比进一步显示，其重建质量具有竞争力，且模型尺寸显著小于水下专用方法。
conclusion: OceanXL为大规模水下3DGS重建提供了快速且可扩展的框架，通过分块优化与自适应剪枝提升训练效率和渲染性能，并贡献了大规模水下数据集，有望推动海洋探索与水下巡检等应用。

title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
abstract: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
tldr: AdaTex4D按可见度梯度为4D高斯自适应分配各向异性纹理容量，纹理存储减半且质量不降。
motivation: 纹理高斯虽能提升局部外观表达能力，但对每个基元统一分配相同的纹理分辨率，会在低细节或弱可见区域造成存储浪费，难以在有限内存下高效分配外观容量。
method: 提出 AdaTex4D 自适应纹理容量模块，用于基于变形的 4D Gaussian Splatting；每个高斯携带打包的 RGBA 三平面（triplanes），其两条纹理轴依据经可见性归一化的屏幕空间梯度与变形后的局部尺度独立增长，从而实现动态、各向异性的纹理分配。
result: 在 N3DV 与 PanopticSports 数据集上，AdaTex4D 将纹理存储减少一半以上且保持重建质量；在固定内存预算下，其自适应分配相比均匀纹理分配取得更高质量，并降低整体模型内存与峰值内存。
conclusion: 结果表明动态、各向异性的纹理容量分配能更高效地在 4D 高斯表示中分配局部外观表达能力，为兼顾渲染质量与存储/内存开销提供了新的思路。

title: SplatLabel: Pseudo-Labelling through 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: While 2D Vision Foundation Models offer a pathway to automate 3D semantic pseudo-labelling, translating these priors into robust 3D representations typically requires complex heuristics or multi-model ensembles. We introduce SplatLabel, an automated pipeline that leverages a 4D Gaussian representation to extract LiDAR segmentation with predictive confidence, as well as semantic occupancy grids at arbitrary voxel resolutions. At its core, SplatLabel handles dynamic environments through an explicit temporal manifold that models the trajectories and lifespans of individual 3D primitives. This allows the system to accurately track moving actors and strictly define when objects appear and disappear, completely eliminating the need for pre-annotated 3D bounding boxes. To robustly support this dynamic tracking, the representation is grounded by structural and semantic priors: we guide scene geometry in unobserved regions by integrating 360-degree LiDAR via virtual depth maps, and rather than relying on domain-specific prompt engineering, we directly distill continuous soft probabilities from 2D models to inherently resolve semantic ambiguities over time and space. Finally, to accurately reflect the real-world trade-off between precision and recall, we reframe pseudo-label evaluation as a selective classification task using a generalized risk-recall metric. Experiments on SemanticKITTI demonstrate that SplatLabel consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple recall levels, establishing a highly robust framework for both 3D LiDAR segmentation and occupancy prediction.
tldr: SplatLabel利用4D高斯表示实现动态场景的LiDAR分割与语义占据伪标签自动化。
motivation: 针对2D视觉基础模型自动化3D语义伪标签时，现有方法通常依赖复杂启发式或多模型集成，且难以处理动态环境中目标的出现与消失。
method: SplatLabel构建4D高斯表示，通过显式时间流形建模每个3D基元的轨迹与生命周期，从而跟踪运动目标并确定其出现/消失，无需预标注3D边界框；同时利用360度LiDAR经虚拟深度图引导未观测区域几何，并从2D模型蒸馏连续软概率以消解时空语义歧义，输出带置信度的LiDAR分割和任意体素分辨率的语义占据栅格。还将伪标签评估重设为选择性分类，采用广义风险-召回指标。
result: 在SemanticKITTI上，SplatLabel在多个召回率水平下持续优于最先进基线，验证了其在3D LiDAR分割与占据预测上的鲁棒性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: SplatLabel消除了对预标注3D边界框的需求，为动态场景下的3D LiDAR分割与语义占据预测提供了高鲁棒性自动伪标签框架，并推动了伪标签评估向选择性分类范式转变。

title: Anatomy-Aligned Surface Field Learning for Myocardial Reconstruction from Sparse Short-Axis Cine MRI
abstract: Patient-specific 4D myocardial reconstruction from cine MRI supports quantitative functional assessment, regional motion analysis, and simulation-based modeling. However, routinely acquired short-axis (SAX) cine MRI is sparsely sampled along the through-plane direction, making dense and anatomically consistent surface reconstruction challenging. In this study, we propose an anatomy-aligned surface learning framework that parameterizes the epicardial and endocardial surfaces on a shared circumferential-longitudinal UV domain. This formulation converts irregular 3D reconstruction into structured coordinate-field completion with explicit correspondence across subjects and cardiac phases. Sparse SAX contours are encoded as UV observation fields, coverage-aware sampling improves robustness to incomplete slice coverage, and topology- and distortion-aware learning preserves circumferential continuity and local surface quality. Experiments on three public cine MRI datasets showed that the proposed method consistently outperformed representative mesh-based and implicit reconstruction approaches, achieving overall Chamfer distances of $2.887$~mm on ACDC, $2.641$~mm on M\&Ms, and $2.810$~mm on M\&Ms-2. The reconstructed sequences also preserved ventricular function, with end-diastolic volume and ejection fraction errors of $3.3$~mL and $1.1 \%$, respectively. These results demonstrate that anatomy-aligned UV learning provides an accurate, efficient, and correspondence-aware representation for sparse cine MRI reconstruction and myocardial modeling. The source code will be available at https://github.com/yuan-xiaohan/SAX2MyoSurf.
tldr: 提出解剖对齐UV表面场学习，从稀疏短轴cine MRI重建4D心肌表面，精度优于网格与隐式重建方法。
motivation: 患者特异性4D心肌重建可用于定量功能评估、区域运动分析与仿真建模，但常规短轴cine MRI沿穿平面方向采样稀疏，导致稠密且解剖一致的心肌表面重建困难。
method: 该方法将心外膜和心内膜表面参数化到共享的 circumferential-longitudinal UV 域，把不规则3D重建转化为结构化坐标场补全，并显式建立跨受试者与心动周期的对应关系；同时用覆盖感知采样增强不完整层面覆盖下的鲁棒性，用拓扑与畸变感知学习保持环向连续性和局部表面质量。
result: 在三个公开cine MRI数据集上，该方法一致优于代表性mesh-based与implicit重建方法，Chamfer距离分别为ACDC 2.887 mm、M&Ms 2.641 mm、M&Ms-2 2.810 mm；重建序列还保持心室功能，EDV与EF误差分别为3.3 mL和1.1%。
conclusion: 结果表明，解剖对齐UV学习为稀疏cine MRI重建与心肌建模提供了准确、高效且具有对应感知能力的表示，源代码将在GitHub开源。

title: FMCW-LIO: A Doppler LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
abstract: Conventional LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) or simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) methods heavily rely on geometric features of environments, as LiDARs primarily provide range measurements instead of motion measurements. From now on, however, the situation changes thanks to the novel Frequency Modulated Continuous Wave (FMCW) Doppler LiDARs. FMCW Doppler LiDARs not only offer the point range with high resolution but also capture the instant point Doppler velocity through the Doppler effect. In the letter, we propose FMCW-LIO, a novel and robust LIO, leveraging intrinsic Doppler measurements from FMCW Doppler LiDARs. To correctly exploit Doppler velocities, a motion compensation method is designed, and a Doppler-aided observation model is applied for on-manifold state estimation. Then, dynamic points can be effectively removed by the Doppler criteria, deriving more consistent geometric observations. FMCW-LIO eventually achieves accurate state estimation and static mapping, even in structure-degenerated environments. Extensive experiments in diverse scenes are performed and FMCW-LIO outperforms other algorithms on both accuracy and robustness.
tldr: 提出FMCW-LIO，利用FMCW多普勒激光雷达的瞬时速度进行运动补偿与流形状态估计，实现退化场景鲁棒里程计。
motivation: 传统LIO/SLAM主要依赖环境几何特征，激光雷达测距不直接提供运动信息，在结构退化环境中容易失效。FMCW多普勒激光雷达可同时提供高分辨率距离与瞬时多普勒速度，为提升LIO鲁棒性提供了新机遇。
method: 设计针对FMCW多普勒速度的运动补偿方法，并构建多普勒辅助观测模型，在流形上进行状态估计；利用多普勒准则剔除动态点，从而获得更一致的几何观测。
result: 在多种场景下进行了大量实验，FMCW-LIO在精度和鲁棒性上优于其他算法，并在结构退化环境中实现准确状态估计与静态建图。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: FMCW-LIO表明融合FMCW多普勒速度能有效增强LIO在动态与结构退化场景中的表现，为多普勒激光雷达SLAM提供了新思路。

title: Only What Was Seen: Observation-Gram Compaction of View-Dependent Appearance in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Most of the memory of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model holds spherical-harmonic colour coefficients, yet each Gaussian is seen only from the narrow cone of directions of the training cameras. We turn this into a distortion metric that other compressors can adopt: a per-Gaussian observation Gram matrix, accumulated from viewing directions and blending weights, is the exact first-order map from coefficient changes to squared image error and needs only the model and the camera poses. Under it, degree reduction becomes a closed-form projection that generalises truncation, degree allocation a Lagrangian rate-distortion problem, and vector quantisation the matrix-weighted Lloyd algorithm, of which Compressed3D's quantiser is the scalar case. Swapped into Compressed3D with everything else unchanged, the metric raises PSNR by +0.49 dB before fine-tuning, with SSIM and LPIPS following, and at matched rate still gains +0.32 dB without a single training image. A training-free stack built on the metric alone is 15% smaller than the image-free GSICO at equal quality on Mip-NeRF 360.
tldr: 提出观测Gram矩阵作为3DGS球谐颜色压缩的失真度量，实现无需训练图像的视图相关外观压缩。
motivation: 3DGS模型的大部分内存用于存储球谐颜色系数，但每个高斯仅从训练相机的窄视锥方向被观测，大量未观测方向的系数造成冗余；现有压缩器未充分利用这一观测受限特性。
method: 从训练相机位姿与混合权重为每个高斯累积观测Gram矩阵，作为系数变化到图像平方误差的精确一阶映射；基于该度量将阶数约简化为闭式投影、阶数分配化为拉格朗日率失真问题、矢量量化化为矩阵加权Lloyd算法，并指出Compressed3D量化器是其标量特例。
result: 替换Compressed3D的度量且其余不变时，微调前PSNR提升+0.49 dB，SSIM与LPIPS同步改善；匹配码率下无训练图像仍提升+0.32 dB；仅用该度量的免训练方案在Mip-NeRF 360上等质量时比image-free GSICO小15%。
conclusion: 表明利用相机观测方向可精确刻画视图相关外观压缩的失真，统一解释并泛化阶数截断、阶数分配和向量量化；为无需训练图像的3DGS压缩提供有效度量，并可被其他压缩器采用。

title: PlenoCI: Plenoptic CharacterIstics for View Dependence Aware Change Classification
abstract: Radiance field representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) natively encode complex visual phenomena such as occlusions and view dependence, but they are inherently underconstrained. Independently optimized reconstructions converge to different primitive configurations, even in unchanged regions. We introduce Plenoptic CharacterIstics (PlenoCI), a novel feature built from the plenoptic field these representations approximate. PlenoCI directly captures rich visual behaviors while ignoring Lambertian textures. By deriving closed-form analytic plenoptic derivatives from a 3DGS representation, we efficiently detect these 5D structures. Our approach is robust to underconstrained representations by construction, reporting two orders of magnitude fewer false positives between independent reconstructions of unchanged scenes than concurrent work. We demonstrate PlenoCI's utility on change classification. First, we detect changes with an instance-aware 3DGS pipeline, achieving state-of-the-art results on CL-Splats with a 25.7% mIoU gain over the strongest competitor, while remaining competitive on the more challenging PASLCD benchmark. Leveraging PlenoCI, we classify changes as geometric or appearance-based with a balanced accuracy of 0.735, comparable to the best performing baseline. We believe plenoptic derivatives and PlenoCI open new directions for view dependence aware understanding in visually complex environments. Code and data are available at https://js0n-lai.github.io/plenoci.
tldr: 提出PlenoCI特征，通过3DGS闭式plenoptic导数实现视图依赖感知的变化检测与分类。
motivation: 辐射场表示（如3DGS）虽能编码遮挡与视图依赖等复杂视觉现象，但其欠约束性导致独立优化在未变化区域也产生不同基元配置，易造成变化检测假阳性。因此需要构建对欠约束鲁棒且能感知视图依赖的变化分类特征。
method: 提出PlenoCI，从3DGS所逼近的plenoptic场中构造特征，并推导闭式解析plenoptic导数以高效检测5D结构；该特征直接刻画丰富视觉行为而忽略Lambertian纹理。基于实例感知3DGS流水线进行变化检测，并利用PlenoCI将变化分类为几何变化或外观变化。
result: 在未变化场景的独立重建间，PlenoCI相比同期工作减少两个数量级的假阳性；在CL-Splats上较最强竞争者mIoU提升25.7%，在PASLCD上保持竞争力；几何/外观变化分类平衡准确率达0.735，与最佳基线相当。
conclusion: PlenoCI对欠约束表示具有构造性鲁棒性，为视觉复杂环境中的视图依赖感知理解提供新方向；代码与数据已公开。

title: Task-Induced Riemannian Metrics for Vision Transformer Feature Spaces
abstract: Methods operating on Vision Transformer (ViT) feature spaces typically rely on Euclidean distance or cosine similarity. This assumes that every direction is equally meaningful, but there is no reason to believe the true task geometry has this property. The task-sensitive geometry of the feature space is given by the pullback metric $g(F) = J(F)^\top J(F)$, where $J$ is the Jacobian of the decoder's output fed to a task-specific distance, with respect to the features. Storing the full $g$ is infeasible at modern scales, and for dense outputs such as depth maps even forming $J$ is impractical. We show that whether a low-rank approximation of this metric can be learned depends on the model-decoder pair, and we characterize this with a matrix-free diagnostic $κ_{cap}(r)$ computable with a low number of Jacobian-vector products. For tractable pairs, we develop the Spectral Pullback Network (SPN), which learns a low-rank version of the metric from randomized power iteration, and we distill it into a $310$K-parameter importance head that predicts token importance directly from the features. When the Jacobian spectrum is too spread out for a low-rank approximation, passing the decoder's input features through a VAE bottleneck can restore tractability. Across DPT, DINOv2, CLIP, and VGGT backbones, $κ_{cap}(r)$ predicts which learned-metric architectures are viable. The importance head reaches Spearman $ρ= 0.998$ on DINOv2 CLS, and our geometric token pruning reduces the additional depth error of ToMe-based token selection by $25\%$ on DPT depth at prune ratio $0.5$, without fine-tuning the ViT. Project page: https://cyberiada.github.io/TaskInducedViTs/
tldr: 提出任务诱导的ViT特征空间黎曼度量，用低秩SPN与重要性头实现无需微调的几何token剪枝。
motivation: Vision Transformer特征空间通常以欧氏距离或余弦相似度度量，隐含各方向等权假设，但任务真实几何并非如此。论文旨在学习任务敏感的特征空间黎曼度量，并解决全度量存储与计算在大规模、稠密输出下不可行的问题。
method: 定义pullback度量 g(F)=J^T J，并提出矩阵无关诊断 κ_cap(r) 判断模型-解码器对能否低秩学习；对可处理对，提出Spectral Pullback Network (SPN) 用随机幂迭代学习低秩度量，并蒸馏为310K参数重要性头，直接由特征预测token重要性。若Jacobian谱过散，则通过VAE瓶颈恢复可处理性。
result: 在DPT、DINOv2、CLIP、VGGT上，κ_cap(r)能预测哪些学习度量架构可行；重要性头在DINOv2 CLS上达到Spearman ρ=0.998；几何token剪枝在DPT深度、剪枝率0.5时，将ToMe式token选择带来的额外深度误差降低25%，且无需微调ViT。
conclusion: 研究表明ViT特征空间可学习任务诱导的低秩黎曼度量，并提供诊断与蒸馏框架，将几何度量用于高效token剪枝。该方法无需微调即可提升下游密集任务效率与精度，为任务感知特征几何建模提供新思路。

title: DAVIO: Dense Monocular-Inertial SLAM with Feed-Forward Initialization and Pose-Conditioned Mapping
abstract: A camera and an IMU are the minimal sensor setup for metric localization and dense mapping, yet classical visual--inertial filters must wait for parallax before they start and then retain only sparse landmarks. Feed-forward geometry models, in contrast, predict dense structure from a few images but provide neither metric scale nor gravity. We present DAVIO, which uses a single multi-view depth model, Depth Anything~3, for both start-up and mapping. At start-up, a five-image window and preintegrated IMU measurements form a feature-free linear system. Its robust, conditioning-checked solution bootstraps a VIO filter through buffered replay. During tracking, the filter's metric poses condition the depth model. Residual scale is corrected only along viewing rays, which preserves the metric camera baselines, and a gravity-preserving submap graph with drift-gated revisits refines the map. On EuRoC, DAVIO starts markedly earlier, reduces the localization error, and maps more accurately than SOTA feed-forward mappers given identical poses. On building-scale ORI sequences, DAVIO is on bar or better than SOTA mappers on the same odometry, and degrades far less when GT poses are replaced by real odometry. We release the code of DAVIO, a real-time dense metric SLAM system, to the community.
tldr: DAVIO利用Depth Anything 3实现免特征初始化与位姿条件化稠密建图，构建实时稠密度量单目惯性SLAM。
motivation: 相机加IMU是度量定位与稠密建图的最小传感器配置，但传统视觉惯性滤波器必须等待足够视差才能启动，且只能保留稀疏路标点；而前馈几何模型虽能从少量图像预测稠密结构，却无法提供度量尺度和重力方向，二者难以兼得。
method: 统一使用单个多视图深度模型Depth Anything 3同时服务于启动与建图：启动阶段以五帧图像窗口结合预积分IMU测量构建无特征线性系统，通过带条件数检查的鲁棒求解并借助缓冲重放来引导VIO滤波器；跟踪阶段用滤波器的度量位姿条件化深度模型，仅沿视线方向校正残余尺度以保持相机基线度量性，并用保重力的子图图结构与漂移门控回访来优化地图。
result: 在EuRoC数据集上，DAVIO启动明显更早、定位误差更低，且在给定相同位姿时建图精度优于SOTA前馈建图方法；在建筑尺度的ORI序列上，使用相同里程计时性能与SOTA建图方法相当或更优，且当GT位姿被真实里程计替换时性能退化远小于对比方法。
conclusion: DAVIO证明了前馈深度模型可为单目惯性SLAM同时提供免特征启动与位姿条件化稠密建图，并已作为实时稠密度量SLAM系统开源发布，有望推动稠密度量SLAM在真实场景中的落地。

title: Know-Your-Scene (KYS)-SLAM: Hierarchical Semantic-Motion Priors for Feature Matching in Stereo Visual SLAM
abstract: Stereo visual SLAM systems built on local descriptors suffer from semantic ambiguity, instance-level confusion, and independently moving objects, each corrupting data association and accumulating as trajectory drift. Prevailing semantic and dynamic SLAM methods address this through binary feature rejection, sacrificing correspondence density for outlier suppression. We contend that contextual implausibility is better expressed as a graded quantity than an exclusion criterion. We present Know-Your-Scene (KYS)-SLAM, a modular extension of ORB-SLAM3 that supplants feature rejection with continuous correspondence modulation. The contribution is the reframing of contextual evidence as correspondence cost, applied within feature matching and leaving the geometric backend unmodified. Each keypoint is augmented with semantic, panoptic, and motion priors fused through a hierarchical compatibility formulation, in which semantic class and instance identity enforce structural plausibility while a zero-shot motion score down-weights features on independently moving objects. That score comes from a training-free module fitting a depth-aware ego-motion model to background optical flow and classifying panoptic segments via self-calibrating, coverage-aware thresholds, so only segments with sufficient motion evidence are penalized and static structure is left unpenalized. Penalizing correspondences rather than discarding them preserves the geometric support bundle adjustment depends on. Under one fixed configuration, no coefficient retuned per sequence or dataset, KYS-SLAM reduces per-sequence ATE RMSE by 17.4% on outdoor KITTI and 27.7% on indoor EuRoC across 21 stereo sequences with no regressions, and by 6.6% on dynamic subsets of KITTI Tracking and 17.8%, up to 31.2%, on Virtual KITTI 2 -- cross-domain transfer across outdoor driving, indoor flight, and synthetic imagery under one set of constants.
tldr: KYS-SLAM将语义、全景与零样本运动先验融合为连续匹配代价，在ORB-SLAM3上以统一配置显著降低轨迹误差。
motivation: 基于局部描述子的立体视觉SLAM易受语义歧义、实例级混淆和独立运动物体干扰，导致数据关联错误并累积为轨迹漂移；现有语义与动态SLAM方法采用二值特征剔除，以牺牲匹配密度换取外点抑制。
method: KYS-SLAM将上下文证据重构为匹配代价而非剔除准则，在特征匹配阶段对每个关键点融合语义、全景与运动先验，通过分层兼容性公式施加连续调制，几何后端保持不变；运动分数由免训练模块拟合深度感知自运动模型到背景光流，并以自校准、覆盖感知阈值对全景片段分类，仅惩罚具有充分运动证据的片段，静态结构不受惩罚。
result: 在单一固定配置、不针对序列或数据集调参的条件下，KYS-SLAM在21条立体序列上使KITTI户外每序列ATE RMSE降低17.4%、EuRoC室内降低27.7%，且无退化；在KITTI Tracking动态子集上降低6.6%，在Virtual KITTI 2上降低17.8%至31.2%。
conclusion: 结果表明，将上下文证据表达为连续匹配代价优于二值特征剔除，可在不修改几何后端的前提下保持BA所需的几何支撑，并在户外驾驶、室内飞行与合成图像间实现单一常数集的跨域泛化，为语义动态SLAM提供了模块化且鲁棒的方案。

title: SatUnreal: A High-Precision Synthetic Dataset for Satellite Stereo Matching via Unreal Engine
abstract:
3D reconstruction from satellite imagery is essential for large-scale topographic analysis, yet the lack of high-fidelity training datasets with accurate occlusion labels remains a primary bottleneck. Existing benchmarks, such as US3D and WHU-Stereo, face inherent challenges in spatio-temporal mismatch -- environmental changes and shadow displacements between multi-view acquisitions -- and provide ambiguous ground truth in occluded regions due to LiDAR sparsity. In this paper, we propose SatUnreal, a high-precision synthetic dataset designed to fundamentally overcome these limitations through an Unreal Engine-based simulation pipeline. SatUnreal provides 10,000 stereo pairs with high resolution (0.3m GSD) and is characterized by: (1) Physical Geometry Simulation, replicating realistic satellite orbits by systematically varying baselines and azimuths; (2) Spatio-temporal Consistency, eliminating temporal noise through fixed virtual environments; (3) Topographic Diversity, spanning dense urban canyons to low-texture natural terrains; and (4) Mathematical Label Integrity, utilizing a novel two-step linetrace algorithm to generate flawless occlusion masks. Experimental results using SOTA iterative models demonstrate that models trained exclusively on SatUnreal achieve superior zero-shot transfer performance on real-world benchmarks (US3D, WHU-Stereo) compared to those trained on real datasets. Our findings prove that physically accurate synthetic data provides a more effective supervisory signal for learning geometric features than complex real-world observations, establishing a new paradigm for Sim-to-Real transfer in Earth Observation.
  Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/jmp-Telepix/SatUnreal_A_High-Precision_Synthetic_Dataset_for_Satellite_Stereo_Matching_via_UnrealEngine
tldr: 提出Unreal Engine合成数据集SatUnreal，含1万对0.3m GSD立体影像与精确遮挡标签，零样本迁移优于真实数据训练。
motivation: 卫星影像三维重建缺乏高保真且遮挡标签准确的训练数据；US3D、WHU-Stereo等现有基准存在多视角时空不匹配、阴影位移和LiDAR稀疏导致的遮挡区真值模糊问题。
method: 基于Unreal Engine构建仿真流水线，生成10,000对0.3m GSD立体影像；通过变化基线与方位角模拟卫星轨道，固定虚拟环境保证时空一致，覆盖城市峡谷到低纹理自然地物，并提出两步linetrace算法生成无瑕遮挡掩膜。
result: SatUnreal包含10,000对0.3m GSD立体影像；实验显示仅用其训练的SOTA迭代模型在US3D、WHU-Stereo上的零样本迁移性能超过用真实数据训练的模型，但摘要未给出具体定量指标。
conclusion: 证明物理准确的合成数据比复杂真实观测能为学习几何特征提供更有效监督信号，为地球观测中的Sim-to-Real迁移建立新范式，并公开代码与数据集。

title: GaussPDE: Graph-Based Partial Differential Equation-Driven Rendering for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: We present GaussPDE, a framework that injects physically structured partial differential equation (PDE) dynamics into pretrained 3D Gaussian scenes without mesh extraction, voxelization, or retraining. Our key observation is that PDE rendering requires not only accurate appearance, but also a reliable discrete computational domain. We therefore first introduce camera-aware regularization during 3DGS reconstruction to suppress camera-near floaters and oversized primitives that would create unstable graph topology. We then construct an active Gaussian graph using covariance-aware distances and opacity, appearance, and boundary-aware conductance, enabling mass-weighted graph Laplacian PDE evolution directly over Gaussian primitives. The evolving scalar PDE state is coupled back to rendering by modifying the direct-current spherical harmonic color coefficients while preserving geometry, opacity, and view-dependent rendering behavior. Experiments on real and synthetic scenes show that GaussPDE produces stable, controllable, and spatially coherent dynamic visualizations, with reduced cross-boundary leakage compared with baselines.
tldr: GaussPDE在预训练3D Gaussian场景上构建图拉普拉斯PDE演化并耦合渲染，实现稳定可控的动态可视化。
motivation: 为在预训练3D Gaussian场景中注入PDE动力学而无需网格提取、体素化或重训练，核心问题是PDE渲染既需准确外观，也需可靠离散计算域；3DGS中相机附近浮点和超大基元会破坏图拓扑稳定性。
method: 方法在3DGS重建阶段引入相机感知正则化以抑制近相机浮点与超大基元；随后以协方差感知距离及不透明度、外观、边界感知电导构建活跃Gaussian图，并在高斯基元上执行质量加权图拉普拉斯PDE演化；最后将PDE标量状态通过修改直流球谐颜色系数耦合回渲染，同时保持几何、不透明度与视角相关渲染行为。
result: 在真实与合成场景上，GaussPDE生成稳定、可控且空间连贯的动态可视化，并较基线降低跨边界泄漏；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: GaussPDE证明可直接在预训练3D Gaussian图结构上演化PDE并耦合渲染，无需网格提取、体素化或重训练；其贡献在于为3DGS提供物理结构化动态可视化途径，并提升跨边界一致性与可控性，有望推动物理仿真与神经渲染结合。

title: PePESeg3D: Perception Prior Enhances Multi-Scale Segmentation for 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Recent advancements in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have extended its capabilities to multi-scale segmentation. Existing methods reconstruct a scene with Gaussian primitives and learn multi-scale segmentation features separately, which leaves the geometry unaware of semantic structure and the feature learning dependent on incomplete mask supervision. To address these limitations, we present PePESeg3D, a novel framework that injects perception priors into a multi-scale 3D Gaussian segmentation pipeline. To fully exploit perception priors, we integrate them not only into contrastive feature learning but also into the upstream geometry reconstruction. Specifically, PePE Reconstruction incorporates monocular depth and mask constraints to ensure semantically coherent object structures. Building on this aligned geometry, PePE Contrastive Learning leverages dense depth-color cues and view-consistent centroid supervision to compensate for the incompleteness of multi-scale masks obtained from a 2D foundation model. Extensive experiments on the SPIn-NeRF, LERF-Mask, and NVOS benchmarks demonstrate that PePESeg3D achieves state-of-the-art performance in both multi-scale segmentation and scene reconstruction, highlighting the importance of integrating perception priors into both geometry optimization and feature learning for accurate multi-scale 3D segmentation. Our code is available at https://github.com/BeCow5X5/PePESeg3D.
tldr: PePESeg3D 将感知先验注入 3DGS 几何重建与对比特征学习，提升多尺度 3D 分割与重建性能。
motivation: 现有 3DGS 多尺度分割方法将高斯重建与分割特征学习分离，导致几何缺乏语义结构感知，且特征学习依赖不完整的掩码监督。该工作旨在通过注入感知先验，同时改善几何对齐与语义特征学习以解决上述问题。
method: 提出 PePESeg3D 框架，将感知先验同时融入上游几何重建与对比特征学习。其中 PePE Reconstruction 引入单目深度和掩码约束以生成语义一致的对象结构，PePE Contrastive Learning 利用稠密深度-颜色线索和视角一致质心监督，弥补 2D 基础模型多尺度掩码的不完整性。
result: 在 SPIn-NeRF、LERF-Mask 和 NVOS 基准上，PePESeg3D 在多尺度分割与场景重建任务中均达到 state-of-the-art；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，将感知先验同时融入几何优化和特征学习对准确的多尺度 3D 分割至关重要。该框架为 3DGS 语义分割与场景重建提供了有效方案，代码已开源以促进后续研究。

title: φ-RIE: From Photorealistic Reconstruction to Interactive Environments
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) can reconstruct a captured scene photorealistically, but the resulting representation does not by itself support physical interaction. Robot simulation instead requires object-level change, \textit{i.e.}, objects must move independently, make contact, and reveal previously occluded surroundings. This gap arises because object appearance may remain entangled with the background, while hidden object geometry and occluded background content may be unobserved. To address this challenge, we present φ-RIE, a Gaussian-native pipeline that converts selected objects into movable simulator assets while preserving the remaining reconstruction. Our key observation is that asset construction and source removal should be coupled, \textit{i.e.}, one object identity should define the movable asset and the scene content to remove and complete. Accordingly, Scene Observation supplies shared evidence to Coupled Scene Construction, which creates registered assets and completed background Gaussians for simulator-driven rendering in an Interactive Environment. This coupling preserves unedited Gaussians while aligning visual and physical state. On 50 ScanNet++ scenes, evidence-based selection and registration retry increase matched F1 at 20\,mm from 0.336 to 0.383 at fixed retention. Further tests demonstrate asset executability, manipulation gains over a single-generator baseline, and the visual cost of conversion. Together, these results demonstrate that \name\ enables interactive scene conversion.
tldr: φ-RIE 通过耦合资产构建与源移除，将 3DGS 重建场景转为可交互仿真环境。
motivation: 3DGS 能对捕获场景进行照片级重建，但其表示本身不支持物理交互；机器人仿真需要物体独立移动、接触并显露原先遮挡的环境。该差距源于物体外观可能仍与背景纠缠，且隐藏物体几何与被遮挡背景内容未被观测。
method: 提出 φ-RIE，一种 Gaussian-native 流水线，将选定物体转换为可移动仿真资产，同时保留其余重建。核心是耦合资产构建与源移除：以同一物体身份定义需移除并补全的场景内容；Scene Observation 为 Coupled Scene Construction 提供共享证据，生成已配准资产和补全的背景 Gaussians，供 Interactive Environment 中由仿真器驱动渲染。该耦合保留未编辑 Gaussians，并对齐视觉与物理状态。
result: 在 50 个 ScanNet++ 场景上，基于证据的选择与配准重试在固定保留率下将 20 mm 匹配 F1 从 0.336 提升至 0.383；其他实验验证了资产生成可执行性、相对单生成器基线的操作性能增益及转换的视觉代价。
conclusion: 实验表明 φ-RIE 可实现交互式场景转换，在保持视觉一致性的同时支持物体操作与仿真。其贡献在于提出面向 3DGS 的物体级可交互资产构建与背景补全耦合框架，有望推动机器人仿真、具身智能和交互式数字孪生应用。

title: GTR: Gated Token Recurrence for Efficient Dense Prediction
abstract: Self-attention-based vision backbones perform well on dense prediction, but the quadratic computational cost of global softmax attention limits their efficiency as image resolution increases. We introduce Gated Token Recurrence (GTR), a softmax-free recurrent vision backbone that combines gated linear attention, alternating spatial scan directions, and spatially enhanced SwiGLU blocks. GTR is distilled from a detection-specialized DINOv3 teacher using only final-layer patch-token alignment through a linear projection and squared $\ell_2$ loss, without masked-token prediction or intermediate-layer supervision. With Objects365 detector pre-training, GTR-L achieves 58.9 box AP on COCO \texttt{val2017} with 1.908\,ms median batch-one latency under compiled FP16 execution on an RTX~4090. The same backbone also transfers to instance segmentation, pose estimation, oriented detection, semantic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. In an isolated kernel benchmark, our specialized chunkwise CUDA operator is $4.0\times$ faster than FLA v0.5.0 at 1.6K tokens on RTX~4090. TensorRT deployment on DRIVE AGX Thor achieves 2.282--8.769\,ms median batch-one latency across the evaluated models. These results show that recurrent token mixing can provide an efficient alternative to global softmax attention for high-resolution dense prediction and edge deployment.Project page: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/GTR/
tldr: 提出无softmax的门控令牌循环GTR，以线性注意力与交替扫描实现高效密集预测。
motivation: 自注意力视觉主干在密集预测上表现优异，但全局softmax注意力的二次计算成本随图像分辨率升高而严重限制效率。GTR旨在为高分辨率密集预测和边缘部署提供更高效的令牌混合替代方案。
method: GTR是一种无softmax的循环视觉主干，结合门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向与空间增强SwiGLU块。它仅通过线性投影和平方ℓ2损失对检测专用DINOv3教师的最终层patch token进行对齐蒸馏，无需掩码令牌预测或中间层监督；同时实现专用chunkwise CUDA算子。
result: 在Objects365检测器预训练下，GTR-L在COCO val2017达到58.9 box AP，RTX 4090编译FP16中位batch-one延迟1.908 ms，并可迁移至实例分割、姿态估计、旋转检测、语义分割和单目深度估计。其专用chunkwise CUDA算子在1.6K tokens时比FLA v0.5.0快4.0倍，TensorRT在DRIVE AGX Thor上实现2.282–8.769 ms中位延迟。
conclusion: 结果表明循环令牌混合可作为全局softmax注意力的高效替代，适用于高分辨率密集预测与边缘部署。GTR贡献了一种高效视觉主干、专用CUDA算子及跨任务迁移能力。

title: Vision Foundation Models with Synthetic-Only Training for Monocular Spacecraft Pose Estimation
abstract: We present an improvement on previous spacecraft pose estimation architectures that results in the lowest published mean rotation errors we know of on the SPEED+ lightbox and sunlamp test sets for a known, non-cooperative spacecraft. By using a previously established heatmap-based pose estimation architecture and adapting a large self-supervised ViT foundation model (DINOv3) in place of the smaller convolutional and ViT encoders of previous work, we show that pose estimation accuracy improves from 300M to 840M parameters with no saturation yet observed. We also evaluate our 840M model on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB, measuring single-pass network inference at 133.8 ms per crop with a board draw of 32.0 W. These measurements demonstrate embedded inference feasibility on a processor family with orbital flight heritage. Our resulting model outperforms previous models across lightbox and sunlamp domains while training only on synthetic data. Our best model, using DINOv3 840M adapted with LoRA as the encoder (rank 64, three-seed ensemble with four-rotation test-time augmentation), results in $1.56^\circ$ mean rotation error on sunlamp and $1.17^\circ$ on lightbox, compared to the previous best mean rotation errors we know of on these test sets, $2.66^\circ$ and $1.75^\circ$ by EagerNet.
tldr: 基于DINOv3和LoRA的热图姿态估计模型仅用合成数据训练，在SPEED+上取得最低旋转误差并可在Jetson推理。
motivation: 针对已知非合作航天器的单目姿态估计，现有方法在SPEED+ lightbox和sunlamp测试集上的旋转误差仍较高，且需验证仅用合成数据训练及嵌入式部署的可行性。
method: 在既有热图姿态估计框架中，将较小卷积/ViT编码器替换为自监督ViT基础模型DINOv3，并用LoRA（rank 64）适配840M参数模型，采用三随机种子集成与四旋转测试时增强，仅用合成数据训练；模型从300M扩展至840M时精度持续提升且未见饱和。
result: 最佳模型在sunlamp和lightbox上的平均旋转误差分别为1.56°和1.17°，优于EagerNet的2.66°和1.75°；在Jetson Orin NX 16GB上单次裁剪推理133.8 ms、板卡功耗32.0 W。
conclusion: 证明仅用合成数据训练的视觉基础模型可显著提升航天器姿态估计精度，并能在已在轨飞行验证的Jetson Orin处理器系列上实现嵌入推理，为星上单目姿态估计提供可行方案。

title: Skytopia: Monocular Drone Navigation with Action-Conditioned Latent World Models
abstract: Monocular drone navigation requires reaching a goal in an unseen environment from a single forward-facing camera, which offers few cues for depth and scale. World models address this by modelling how observations evolve under actions, but they are built to be executed: the prediction is produced at deployment and fed back into action generation at every control step. We argue that what a policy needs from a world model is not the prediction but the representation required to produce it: in flight the executed action explains almost all of the change between observations, so prediction reduces to reprojecting a static scene under a known displacement. We therefore introduce skytopia, a policy built on an action-conditioned latent world model, and the 3D Gaussian Splatting platform on which it is trained. A forward objective predicts the representation of the next observation from the intended motion, and an inverse objective recovers that motion from the predicted transition. Because the prediction never reaches action generation, the predictor is discarded and one policy serves point-goal, image-goal, and goal-free navigation. Simulation experiments show that skytopia outperforms every baseline under all three specifications, attaining 57.8%, 66.0%, and 49.0% success rate, while discarding the predictor removes 59.4% of the inference cost. The same policy is subsequently deployed on a physical drone without fine-tuning and reaches goals in indoor, open outdoor, and woodland environments.
tldr: Skytopia用动作条件潜世界模型的表征而非预测来驱动策略，实现单目无人机多目标导航并成功部署到真机。
motivation: 单目无人机仅凭单个前视相机导航时缺乏深度与尺度线索；现有世界模型在部署阶段每步都做预测并反馈给动作生成，推理开销大，而飞行中已执行动作几乎解释了全部观测变化，预测本身并非策略所需。
method: 提出 skytopia：策略建立在动作条件潜世界模型之上，并配套用于训练的3D Gaussian Splatting平台；正向目标由意图运动预测下一观测的表示，逆向目标由预测的状态转移恢复运动；由于预测不参与动作生成，预测器被丢弃，单一策略同时支持点目标、图像目标和目标无关导航。
result: 仿真实验中，skytopia在三种设定下均超越所有基线，成功率分别为57.8%、66.0%和49.0%；丢弃预测器可减少59.4%的推理开销；同一策略无需微调即部署到实体无人机，并在室内、开阔户外和林地环境中成功到达目标。
conclusion: 该工作表明策略真正需要的是世界模型产生预测所需的表征而非预测本身，为单目无人机导航提供了高效且可迁移的方案，并验证了从仿真到真实环境的零微调泛化能力。

title: GRIP: Gaussian Rendering as a Cross-Modal Bridge for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
abstract: This paper introduces GRIP, a pose-conditioned refinement framework for pixel-to-point matching and 2D to 3D registration. Given an initial coarse pose estimate, GRIP addresses the structural mismatch between grid based image descriptors and unordered point cloud descriptors by softly rendering learned 3D point features onto the image grid through Gaussian feature splatting. The rendered point derived feature map is then fused with image features by a pixel aligned transformer, enabling visual semantic and geometric cues to interact in a shared 2D representation. The refined features are decoded and propagated to finer resolutions for dense correspondence estimation and final pose refinement. Experiments on RGB D Scenes V2 and 7 Scenes demonstrate state of the art inlier ratio and competitive registration recall, with stronger performance under stricter evaluation thresholds.
tldr: GRIP利用高斯特征泼溅将3D点特征渲染到图像网格，以跨模态Transformer融合并细化位姿，提升图像到点云配准。
motivation: 图像网格化描述子与无序点云描述子存在结构失配，初始粗位姿下难以获得密集可靠的像素-点对应。GRIP旨在跨模态桥接视觉语义与几何线索，实现精确的2D-3D配准与位姿细化。
method: 给定初始粗位姿，GRIP通过高斯特征泼溅将学习到的3D点特征软渲染到图像网格，生成点云衍生的特征图；再用像素对齐Transformer与图像特征融合，使语义与几何信息在共享2D表示中交互；最后解码并传播至精细分辨率，用于密集对应估计与最终位姿优化。
result: 在RGB-D Scenes V2和7-Scenes上取得最高内点率，配准召回率具竞争力，在更严格评估阈值下性能提升更明显。
conclusion: GRIP验证了高斯渲染作为跨模态桥梁在图像到点云配准中的有效性，通过共享2D表示融合几何与语义，为密集对应和位姿细化提供新思路，并在严格评估下展现鲁棒性。

title: NaCR: Visual Localization via NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression
abstract: Visual localization (VL) is a fundamental technology for vision applications such as virtual reality. Recently, a novel VL paradigm, Camera Ray Regression (CRR), has emerged, which maps 2D image patches to 3D camera rays, but its accuracy is limited. To improve CRR accuracy, we notice a compelling duality: the inverse of this mapping is inherently performed by the novel view synthesis model, \ie, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF). While NeRF renders image patches from camera rays via differentiable ray marching, CRR predicts the rays from image patches. Motivated by this complementary relationship, we propose NeRF-aided Camera Ray Regression (NaCR), a unified framework that seamlessly bridges NeRF and CRR at the ray level. First, NaCR incorporates three simple yet effective enhancements into the CRR baseline. Second, leveraging a pre-trained NeRF, NaCR augments the training data by synthesizing novel views tailored for efficient, patch-level consumption. Finally, exploiting the differentiability of NeRF, NaCR forms a closed-loop supervision pipeline where photometric rendering errors are back-propagated to optimize the predicted camera rays. To ensure stable convergence within the highly non-convex image space, we introduce a two-stage training curriculum. Extensive experiments across indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate that NaCR achieves competitive accuracy. Comprehensive ablation studies validate the efficacy of each proposed component.
tldr: 提出NaCR，用NeRF辅助相机光线回归，通过增强、数据合成与闭环监督提升视觉定位精度。
motivation: 现有Camera Ray Regression（CRR）将2D图像块映射到3D相机光线，但精度有限；而NeRF的渲染过程恰好是CRR的逆映射，二者具有互补对偶关系。该工作旨在利用NeRF提升CRR精度，并在光线层面统一NeRF与CRR。
method: NaCR首先在CRR基线上引入三项简单有效的增强；其次利用预训练NeRF合成面向图像块高效消费的新视角，以扩充训练数据；最后借助NeRF可微性构建闭环监督，将光度渲染误差反向传播以优化预测相机光线，并采用两阶段训练课程保证高非凸图像空间中的稳定收敛。
result: 在室内和室外基准上的大量实验表明，NaCR取得了有竞争力的定位精度；全面消融实验验证了各提出组件的有效性。摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: NaCR在光线层面无缝桥接NeRF与CRR，为视觉定位提供了一种新的统一框架，并展示了利用可微渲染闭环优化相机光线的潜力。其方法有望推动视觉定位与神经渲染结合方向的发展。

title: Dual Covariance Gaussian Splatting SLAM: Decoupling Rendering and Registration for Robust Real-Time Tracking
abstract: ICP-based 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) SLAM tracks in real time by registering incoming frames against map Gaussians, using each primitive's covariance for both rendering and registration. These two uses place conflicting demands on one covariance. The mapper shapes it to minimize photometric error, often flattening it against surfaces, while robust registration typically benefits from measurement uncertainty. We propose a dual-covariance parameterization. Each Gaussian keeps a single mean but holds two covariances: a rendering covariance optimized by the mapper, and a tracking covariance derived from an RGB-D sensor noise model. We further use the tracking covariances as Gaussian anchors for image corners, providing constraints in directions where depth geometry is weak. We evaluate on TUM RGB-D, ScanNet, Replica, and two outdoor sequences recorded with a RealSense D435i on wheeled and handheld platforms. We achieve robust tracking performance across multiple scenes and reduced odometry drift, while tracking at $\sim$ 60 FPS.
tldr: 提出双协方差高斯泼溅SLAM，解耦渲染与配准，利用RGB-D噪声模型提升实时跟踪鲁棒性并降低漂移。
motivation: 现有基于ICP的3DGS SLAM将同一高斯协方差同时用于渲染和配准，但渲染希望优化光度误差而趋向压扁表面，配准则需要反映测量不确定性，二者存在冲突。
method: 提出双协方差参数化：每个高斯仅保留一个均值，同时维护由建图器优化的渲染协方差和由RGB-D传感器噪声模型导出的跟踪协方差；并将跟踪协方差作为图像角点的Gaussian anchors，在深度几何较弱方向提供约束。
result: 在TUM RGB-D、ScanNet、Replica及RealSense D435i在轮式和手持平台采集的两段户外序列上评估，实现多场景鲁棒跟踪并降低里程计漂移，跟踪速度约60 FPS。
conclusion: 通过解耦渲染与配准的协方差需求，方法在保持实时性的同时提升跟踪鲁棒性与精度，为3DGS SLAM提供新的协方差建模思路。

title: Robust, Estimator-Agnostic Dynamic 3DGS Compression
abstract: Dynamic 3D Gaussian splats (3DGS) model time-varying scenes using a separate Gaussian set per frame. While neighboring video frames are highly correlated due to smooth motion, Gaussian representations retain this correlation to varying degrees, depending on whether the estimator tracks them across time. Some 3DGS compression methods integrate the estimation to exploit temporal redundancy; here, we focus on robust compression regardless of the estimator. We concatenate groups of frames into one Gaussian set, augment each Gaussian with a frame index, and pass it to a static (i.e., non-temporal) 3DGS codec, converting temporal redundancy into spatial redundancy. Concatenated sets are spatially partitioned to limit memory. Our technique requires neither a motion model nor knowledge of the training method. Averaged over six N3DV sequences, all six static codecs achieve gains on tracked sets (-42.0% to -71.8% BD-rate) over per-frame coding. On untracked sets, all codecs except HGSC, which appears incompatible with our technique, remain competitive with per-frame coding (-3.5% to +5.0%). We further replace D-FCGS's I-frame coding with our technique while retaining its P-frame coding, yielding an overall BD-rate of -46.2%. We propose to visualize "trackedness" using an inter-frame similarity metric. The project is available at https://wcjj1236.github.io/d3dgs-benchmark.
tldr: 提出与估计器无关的动态3DGS压缩方法，将多帧高斯拼接后送入静态编解码器，显著降低BD-rate。
motivation: 动态3DGS逐帧独立的高斯表示存在时间冗余，但冗余程度取决于估计器是否跨帧跟踪，现有压缩方法常与估计过程耦合，缺乏估计器无关的鲁棒压缩方案。
method: 将若干帧的高斯拼接为一个高斯集，并为每个高斯附加帧索引，送入静态（非时序）3DGS编解码器，把时间冗余转化为空间冗余；对拼接集进行空间划分以限制内存，无需运动模型或训练方法先验。
result: 在六个N3DV序列上，六种静态编解码器对tracked集合相比逐帧编码取得-42.0%至-71.8% BD-rate增益；对untracked集合，除HGSC不兼容外，其余编解码器保持竞争力（-3.5%至+5.0%）；替换D-FCGS的I帧编码并保留P帧编码后，整体BD-rate为-46.2%。
conclusion: 方法无需运动模型且估计器无关，兼容多种静态3DGS编解码器，并可集成到D-FCGS等动态压缩框架中，为动态3DGS压缩提供鲁棒通用方案；还提出用帧间相似度可视化trackedness。

title: Ultra-fast Neural Inference for Stochastic Gaussian Splatting Denoising
abstract: Stochastic rendering eliminates the sorting and alpha blending process in Gaussian splatting, at the cost of introducing spatial noise. Formulating temporal denoising over the pixel stream shared by view-consistent stochastic splatting renderers, we propose a temporal neural denoiser validated on stochastic 2D Gaussian Splatting rendering, combining dual-path exponential moving average accumulation, per-pixel learned trust prediction for history validation, a fixed anisotropic spatial filter and a variance-gated composition with stabilization. The denoiser suppresses the noise, achieving temporally stable, visually compelling outputs during free camera navigation, all while retaining the sort-free, blend-free rasterization performance. The combined pipeline retains a PSNR gap to sorted alpha-blending renderers, but the denoiser's overhead stays below the time saved by removing sorting and blending.
tldr: 提出时序神经去噪器，在随机高斯泼溅免排序免混合渲染中实现稳定快速的降噪。
motivation: 随机渲染消除了高斯泼溅中的排序与alpha混合过程，但会引入空间噪声。研究目标是在保留免排序、免混合光栅化性能的同时抑制噪声，并实现自由视角导航下时序稳定的渲染输出。
method: 将去噪建模为视角一致随机泼溅渲染器共享像素流上的时序去噪，并在随机2D高斯泼溅渲染上验证。方法结合双路径指数移动平均累积、逐像素学习信任预测以验证历史、固定各向异性空间滤波，以及带稳定化的方差门控合成。
result: 去噪器有效抑制噪声，在自由相机导航中生成时序稳定且视觉可观的输出，同时保留免排序、免混合的光栅化性能。与排序alpha混合渲染器相比，组合管线仍存在PSNR差距，但去噪器开销低于移除排序和混合所节省的时间。
conclusion: 该工作表明时序神经去噪可在随机高斯泼溅中实现快速且稳定的渲染，代价是相对排序alpha混合仍有一定PSNR损失。其贡献在于免排序、免混合框架下的实时神经去噪方案，潜在影响是加速高斯泼溅渲染并支持自由视角应用。

title: Agentic Building-Aware Satellite Gaussian Splatting for Auditable Urban DSM Reconstruction
abstract: Urban-scale 3D reconstruction from satellite imagery supports disaster response, city monitoring, and geospatial digital twins, yet neural rendering methods typically optimize average visual fidelity rather than the structures that analysts inspect first: buildings. We present an agentic building-aware satellite Gaussian Splatting workflow that uses Segment Anything-derived building masks as semantic priors and an Agentic Reconstruction Controller to select, verify, and record DSM reconstruction policies. On the DFC2019 JAX\_004 scene, building-aware weighting reduces building-region DSM MAE from 0.844 m to 0.806 m, showing that semantic priors can shift reconstruction capacity toward analyst-critical regions. A staged schedule provides a balanced operating point, improving full-scene MAE from 1.362 m to 1.349 m while retaining a building gain. Across four JAX scenes, the Agent selects validated policies for both general DSM and building-focused DSM objectives, and produces building-inventory metadata and per-scene decision records. The system combines semantic priors, policy selection, region-specific DSM metrics, and DSM-derived GIS surface products for auditable urban 3D analysis.
tldr: 提出面向建筑感知与可审计的代理式卫星高斯泼溅流程，利用SAM掩码先验和策略控制器改进城市DSM重建。
motivation: 现有卫星影像神经渲染方法主要优化整体视觉保真度，而非分析师首先关注的建筑结构；城市级DSM重建还缺乏可审计的策略选择与区域精度评估。
method: 方法以Segment Anything生成的建筑掩码作为语义先验，构建Agentic Reconstruction Controller，对DSM重建策略进行选择、验证与记录，并采用分阶段调度；在四个JAX场景上执行面向通用DSM和建筑重点DSM目标的策略搜索。
result: 在DFC2019 JAX_004场景中，建筑感知加权将建筑区域DSM MAE从0.844 m降至0.806 m；分阶段调度将全场景MAE从1.362 m降至1.349 m，同时保留建筑增益。系统在四个JAX场景中均选出通过验证的策略，并生成建筑清单元数据与逐场景决策记录。
conclusion: 该工作将语义先验、策略选择、区域特定DSM指标和DSM衍生GIS地表产品结合，提升城市三维分析的可审计性，并为灾害响应、城市监测与数字孪生提供面向建筑的分析能力。

title: Point Diffusion Mamba: Unified Diffusion-State-Space Modeling for Single-View 3D Reconstruction under Data Scarcity
abstract: While single-view 3D reconstruction has seen significant progress, extrapolating complex 3D structures from inherently ambiguous 2D observations remains fundamentally ill-posed, particularly in the critically underexplored data-scarce regime. To address this challenge, we propose Point Diffusion Mamba (PDM), a method that integrates the generative power of diffusion models with the efficiency of state-space model for single-view 3D reconstruction under data-scarce conditions. Specifically, PDM employs a lightweight reconstruction module tailored to handle unordered point-cloud inputs effectively. By combining a Local Geometric Aggregation module with Mamba blocks, our approach jointly models global geometric structures and local details. In 3D reconstruction, each point in the initial noisy input requires a precise prediction, yet the high-level features extracted by the Mamba module capture only abstract semantic information from sparse points. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Hierarchical Feature Integration Network, which fuses high-level semantic and local geometric features for each point, overcoming the limitations of token-based point-cloud reconstruction. Furthermore, we propose a Dynamic Weighted Sampling strategy that adaptively unifies 3D generation with single-view reconstruction by leveraging generative priors to enhance reconstruction quality. Experimental results on the ShapeNet and Pix3D benchmarks demonstrate that PDM outperforms state-of-the-art methods, providing an effective solution for 3D reconstruction under data-scarce settings. Code is available at: https://github.com/NWUzhouwei/PDM.
tldr: 提出PDM，融合扩散模型与状态空间模型，在数据稀缺下实现单视图三维重建。
motivation: 单视图三维重建因二维观测固有歧义而本质病态，尤其在数据稀缺场景中，从稀疏信息推断复杂三维结构仍十分困难且研究不足。
method: 提出 Point Diffusion Mamba（PDM），采用轻量重建模块处理无序点云，结合局部几何聚合模块与 Mamba 块联合建模全局结构和局部细节，并引入分层特征集成网络融合每点的高层语义与局部几何特征；同时提出动态加权采样策略，利用生成先验统一三维生成与单视图重建。
result: 在 ShapeNet 与 Pix3D 基准上，PDM 优于现有最先进方法，验证其在数据稀缺设置下的有效性；摘要未提供具体量化指标。
conclusion: PDM 为数据稀缺下的单视图三维重建提供了有效方案，代码已开源，有望推动扩散模型与状态空间模型在三维重建中的结合。

title: Pose-Aware Multimodal Automatic Tagging for Greek Traditional Music
abstract: Automatic tagging is a core task in Music Information Retrieval (MIR), yet most tagging systems exploit only audio. Live music performance is inherently multimodal, as semantic labels such as instruments, regional styles, and dance forms are encoded simultaneously across acoustic, visual, and embodied performance cues. This is especially true of culturally specific repertoires such as Greek traditional music, which remain underrepresented in MIR benchmarks. In this paper, we investigate whether the use of dancer pose provides complementary information for automatic tagging in Greek traditional music beyond audio. Using the Lyra dataset, we extend prior audio-only work by extracting aligned video features and pose-derived skeleton streams, enabling an experimental setting for multimodal auto-tagging. We further introduce an automated pipeline for extracting primary-dancer skeleton sequences from in-the-wild dance footage, combining dance-scene detection, multi-person tracking, dancer selection, pose estimation, and quality filtering. We compare unimodal, all bimodal combinations, and trimodal systems using multiple fusion strategies. Audio remains the strongest single modality (AST: macro ROC-AUC 0.821), while skeletons, though weak in isolation, enhance performance through multimodal fusion. The best trimodal system improves macro ROC-AUC by about 4 percentage points over the strongest audio baseline.
tldr: 本文研究舞者姿态能否为希腊传统音乐自动标注提供音频之外的互补信息。
motivation: 传统自动标注系统多仅利用音频，而现场音乐中乐器、地域风格和舞蹈形式等标签同时由声学、视觉与身体表演线索编码；希腊传统音乐在MIR基准中仍代表性不足。本文探究舞者姿态是否能为此类音乐自动标注提供音频之外的互补信息。
method: 基于Lyra数据集，在原有纯音频工作上提取对齐的视频特征与姿态骨架流，构建多模态自动标注实验设置。提出从野外舞蹈视频自动提取主舞者骨架序列的流水线，包括舞蹈场景检测、多人跟踪、舞者选择、姿态估计与质量过滤。比较单模态、所有双模态组合与三模态系统及多种融合策略。
result: 音频仍是最强单模态（AST macro ROC-AUC 0.821），骨架单独较弱；通过多模态融合可提升性能。最佳三模态系统较最强音频基线在macro ROC-AUC上提升约4个百分点。
conclusion: 结果表明姿态可提供互补信息，多模态融合能提升希腊传统音乐自动标注效果。贡献包括可扩展的主舞者骨架提取流水线及面向代表性不足音乐文化的多模态标注基准实验，有望推动文化特定MIR研究。

title: GTR: Gated Token Recurrence for Efficient Dense Prediction
abstract: Self-attention-based vision backbones perform well on dense prediction, but the quadratic computational cost of global softmax attention limits their efficiency as image resolution increases. We introduce Gated Token Recurrence (GTR), a softmax-free recurrent vision backbone that combines gated linear attention, alternating spatial scan directions, and spatially enhanced SwiGLU blocks. GTR is distilled from a detection-specialized DINOv3 teacher using only final-layer patch-token alignment through a linear projection and squared $\ell_2$ loss, without masked-token prediction or intermediate-layer supervision. With Objects365 detector pre-training, GTR-L achieves 58.9 box AP on COCO \texttt{val2017} with 1.908\,ms median batch-one latency under compiled FP16 execution on an RTX~4090. The same backbone also transfers to instance segmentation, pose estimation, oriented detection, semantic segmentation, and monocular depth estimation. In an isolated kernel benchmark, our specialized chunkwise CUDA operator is $4.0\times$ faster than FLA v0.5.0 at 1.6K tokens on RTX~4090. TensorRT deployment on DRIVE AGX Thor achieves 2.282--8.769\,ms median batch-one latency across the evaluated models. These results show that recurrent token mixing can provide an efficient alternative to global softmax attention for high-resolution dense prediction and edge deployment. Project page: https://intellindust-ai-lab.github.io/projects/GTR/
tldr: 提出无softmax的GTR循环视觉骨干，用门控线性注意力等实现高效高分辨率密集预测。
motivation: 现有基于自注意力的视觉骨干在密集预测上表现优秀，但全局softmax注意力的二次计算成本随图像分辨率增长而严重限制效率。该工作旨在为高分辨率密集预测和边缘部署提供更高效的token混合替代方案。
method: GTR是一种无softmax的循环视觉骨干，结合门控线性注意力、交替空间扫描方向和空间增强SwiGLU块。它仅通过线性投影和平方L2损失对齐最终层patch token，从检测专用DINOv3教师蒸馏，无需掩码token预测或中间层监督。
result: 在Objects365检测器预训练下，GTR-L在COCO val2017上达到58.9 box AP，RTX 4090编译FP16下median batch-one延迟为1.908 ms；专用chunkwise CUDA算子在1.6K tokens时比FLA v0.5.0快4.0×；TensorRT部署在DRIVE AGX Thor上延迟为2.282–8.769 ms。该骨干还可迁移至实例分割、姿态估计、旋转检测、语义分割和单目深度估计。
conclusion: 结果表明循环token混合可作为全局softmax注意力的高效替代，适用于高分辨率密集预测和边缘部署。贡献包括GTR架构、简洁的最终层蒸馏策略以及高性能CUDA/TensorRT实现。

title: Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.
tldr: 提出混合强化学习端到端视觉运动控制器，在平面果园实现零样本仿真到现实的机器人修剪。
motivation: 休眠期修剪劳动密集且对现代高产果园至关重要，而V-Trellis苹果和UFO樱桃等平面树形系统的自动化修剪仍具挑战。该工作旨在仅用仿真与合成数据学习闭环视觉运动控制器，并零样本部署到真实果园，避免依赖完整三维重建。
method: 构建端到端流水线：合成平面果园树网格、搭建基于物理的果园模拟器、通过运动规划自动采集成功修剪轨迹，并提出结合离线演示与在线仿真展开的混合强化学习算法。控制器以腕装相机光流为输入，持续引导切割器穿越杂乱枝条环境到达指定切割点并保持正确工具朝向。
result: 在覆盖3000个修剪点的穷举式仿真任务空间评估中，策略在V-Trellis苹果上成功率为49.9%，在UFO樱桃上为46.0%。在38项物理试验（28项商业与实验果园户外试验和10项室内实验室测试）中验证了零样本仿真到现实迁移，且学习策略在实验室硬件上优于经典RRT-Connect基线。
conclusion: 结果表明，仅用仿真与合成数据训练的视觉运动控制器可零样本迁移到真实平面果园修剪任务，混合强化学习与光流输入降低了对完整三维重建的依赖。该工作为自动化休眠期修剪提供了可扩展的农业机器人方案，并展示了在商业果园环境中的应用潜力。

title: SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning Directly from Images Without Explicit 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Reaching a 6-DoF grasp pose in clutter requires a collision-free trajectory, conventionally obtained by reconstructing the scene in 3D and planning inside that reconstruction, at the cost of its accuracy and compute. Potential fields learned directly from images remove that dependency but inherit the classical weakness of artificial potential fields: where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel, the descent grazes the obstacle instead of going around it, and can stall short of the goal. We present an SE(3) neural potential field learned from posed RGB images and supervised with a navigation function, the geodesic distance to the grasp through free space recovered from those same images during training, which removes both failures. On two tabletop scenes, from obstacle-blocked starts executed on a UR10, the field converges within 3 cm of the grasp from every start and every path it executes is collision-free against the ground-truth geometry, against 25% and 0% under image supervision alone; mean clearance rises from under a centimeter to 8.6-8.8 cm and arm-link contacts fall from 20.6-50.4% to 2.7-5.5% of executed configurations. Executed grasp success is 90.0% and 40.0% on the two scenes, the residual failures being refusals of the Cartesian executor rather than of the field. Planning takes about 2 s against 67-133 s for RRT* on a reconstruction of the same images, though under a common offline harness the two are comparable: the deployed margin is the cost of collision-checking a dense reconstruction, not planner complexity.
tldr: 提出SE(3)神经势场，直接从RGB图像规划6-DoF无碰撞抓取轨迹，无需显式3D重建。
motivation: 在杂乱环境中到达6-DoF抓取位姿需要无碰撞轨迹，传统方法先重建3D场景再规划，但重建精度与计算成本高。直接从图像学习势场可避免重建，却会继承经典人工势场中引力与斥力梯度抵消导致的贴障滑行和停滞问题。
method: 从带位姿的RGB图像中学习SE(3)神经势场，并在训练时用导航函数监督，该导航函数是从同一批图像恢复的自由空间中到抓取位姿的测地距离。该方法无需显式3D重建，通过势场下降生成6-DoF无碰撞轨迹。
result: 在两个桌面场景、UR10从障碍阻挡的起始点执行时，势场从每个起点都能收敛到抓取位姿3 cm以内，且所有执行路径相对真值几何均无碰撞；仅用图像监督时碰撞率分别为25%和0%。平均间隙从不足1 cm提升到8.6–8.8 cm，机械臂连杆接触配置比例从20.6–50.4%降至2.7–5.5%；两个场景抓取成功率为90.0%和40.0%，剩余失败主要来自笛卡尔执行器拒绝而非势场。规划约需2 s，而基于同一图像重建的RRT*需67–133 s；在统一离线测试框架下两者相当，部署时的差距主要来自稠密重建的碰撞检测成本。
conclusion: 用测地距离导航函数监督基于图像的SE(3)势场，可消除梯度抵消导致的贴障与停滞，实现直接从图像到6-DoF轨迹的规划，并显著提升间隙、降低接触与抓取失败。该方法为杂乱环境中的机器人抓取提供无需显式3D重建的规划范式，其部署速度优势主要来自避免稠密重建碰撞检测。

title: When Wider Views Fail: Stress-Testing Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models enable efficient geometry estimation from sparse images, but their pretrained nature can make them vulnerable to distribution shifts beyond their training data. Identifying these failure modes is important for understanding when such models can be reliably deployed in unconstrained imaging settings. We investigate viewpoint variation as a controlled distribution shift by varying the angular span of sparse image inputs while keeping the input budget fixed. Across multiple feed-forward reconstruction models, we observe substantial degradation as viewpoint span increases, with wide spans producing both incomplete surface coverage and geometry unsupported by the observed imagery. These results reveal that viewpoint variation can induce failure modes beyond conventional reconstruction incompleteness, highlighting the need to evaluate pretrained feed-forward models under distribution shifts that challenge their learned geometric priors.
tldr: 固定输入图像数量、增大视点跨度会显著降低前馈三维重建质量并引发新失效模式。
motivation: 前馈三维重建模型能从稀疏图像高效估计几何，但其预训练特性使其在训练分布之外易受分布偏移影响；理解这些失效模式对无约束成像场景的可靠部署至关重要。
method: 本文将视点变化作为受控分布偏移，在保持输入图像预算固定的前提下改变稀疏输入的角跨度，并在多个前馈重建模型上评估。
result: 实验观察到随着视点跨度增大，重建性能显著退化；宽跨度会导致表面覆盖不完整，并产生观测图像无法支持的几何。
conclusion: 结果表明视点变化会引发超越传统重建不完整性的新失效模式，强调需在挑战学习几何先验的分布偏移下评估预训练前馈模型。

title: Dynamic Thermal Gaussians: Multimodal 4D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: Thermography plays a vital role in military and broader thermal analysis applications. Recent progress in 3D thermal reconstruction has extended temperature analysis from 2D to 3D space, yet most existing works assume static temperature distributions, neglecting the temporal dynamics of heat transfer in real-world environments. To address this limitation, we propose the first dynamic RGB-Thermal reconstruction framework for complex scenes. Our method jointly models RGB appearance, thermal observations, and scene geometry as they change over time. Specifically, we introduce a multimodal dynamic scene representation that anchors both the color and thermal modalities to a shared geometric substrate, ensuring their consistency under spatiotemporal deformations. We further design multimodal embeddings to enhance the motion expressiveness for each modality, and propose a multimodal routing mechanism that retains a unified set of shared multimodal Gaussians as the geometric backbone while adaptively spawning modality-specific Gaussians to strengthen the representational capacity in detail-rich regions of each individual modality. In addition, we contribute a novel benchmark dataset featuring high-frequency temperature variations to facilitate the evaluation of 4D reconstruction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves high-fidelity spatiotemporal reconstruction of both appearance and temperature. Our code and dataset are available at: https://github.com/LinLif1869/DTG.
tldr: 提出首个动态 RGB-Thermal 4D 重建框架，用多模态高斯联合建模外观、温度与几何随时间变化。
motivation: 现有 3D 热重建多假设温度分布静态，忽略真实环境中热传递的时间动态，难以支持军事等热分析所需的动态温度场建模。本文旨在解决复杂场景下 RGB 与热成像的联合动态重建问题。
method: 方法将颜色与热模态锚定到共享几何基底，构建多模态动态场景表示，以保证时空变形下的一致性；并引入多模态嵌入增强各模态运动表达，以及多模态路由机制：保留统一共享多模态高斯作为几何主干，同时自适应生成模态专属高斯以增强细节丰富区域。还贡献了含高频温度变化的 4D 重建基准数据集。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法能够对场景外观和温度进行高保真时空重建；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但代码与数据集已开源。
conclusion: 该工作提出首个动态 RGB-Thermal 重建框架，扩展了热分析从静态 3D 到动态 4D 的能力，并通过新数据集推动 4D 热重建评测。其多模态高斯表示与路由机制有望促进复杂环境下动态热成像建模及相关应用。

title: STA-TFM: Spatio-Temporal Aggregation Across Views TransForMer for Pose Estimation
abstract: Monocular 3D human pose estimation (HPE) remains challenging due to depth ambiguity, occlu- sions, and the need for temporal consistency. While multi-view methods provide superior accuracy over monocular approaches, they often require complex setups. We introduce STA-TFM, a transformer-based architecture that combines spatial and temporal information for multi-view pose estimation. The approach leverages DSTformer, a monocular feature extractor, to capture long-range pose dependencies within each view. A fusion transformer then aggregates information across views to produce coherent 3D estimates. To address training data scarcity, we use a data generation pipeline that transforms any existing 3D pose dataset into multi-view setups with controllable parameters. Experiments on various datasets demonstrate that STA-TFM outperforms existing camera-parameter-free multi-view methods. STA-TFM achieves 50.9% and 49.5% reductions in mean per joint position error (MPJPE) and mean per joint velocity error (MPJVE) on the DHP19 dataset. Furthermore, it achieves 6.7% and 7.7% respective reductions on HAA4D, and a 15.2% MPJPE reduction on TotalCapture. STA-TFM handles noisy and missing 2D inputs, supporting potential deployment in healthcare monitoring, athletic assessment, and immersive technologies. Code, training checkpoints, and data are available at https://zenodo.org/records/22832620.
tldr: 提出STA-TFM，通过跨视角时空聚合Transformer实现3D人体姿态估计，显著降低MPJPE与MPJVE。
motivation: 单目3D人体姿态估计受深度歧义、遮挡和时序一致性不足困扰；多视角方法精度更高但通常需要复杂设置，且训练数据稀缺。
method: STA-TFM以DSTformer作为单目特征提取器捕获每个视角内的长程姿态依赖，再用融合Transformer跨视角聚合信息生成连贯3D估计；同时构建数据生成管线，将任意3D姿态数据集转换为参数可控的多视角设置以缓解数据稀缺。
result: 在多个数据集上，STA-TFM优于现有无需相机参数的多视角方法：DHP19上MPJPE和MPJVE分别降低50.9%和49.5%，HAA4D上分别降低6.7%和7.7%，TotalCapture上MPJPE降低15.2%，并能处理噪声和缺失2D输入。
conclusion: STA-TFM证明了时空聚合与跨视角Transformer在多视角3D姿态估计中的有效性，可支持医疗监测、运动评估和沉浸式技术等潜在部署；代码、训练检查点和数据已公开。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
abstract: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement. Our fully integrated approach achieves at most 37.1\% superiority in CS-MJE over SOTA on HO3D. Project page: https://github.com/Mine268/CS-ViT.
tldr: 提出CS-ViT框架，通过变换同构监督和透视信息嵌入解决单目相机空间手部姿态估计中的深度模糊与耦合问题。
motivation: 单目RGB手部姿态估计中，相机空间估计需同时预测手腕在相机坐标系的位置，面临深度模糊以及局部手姿与全局手腕位置在透视投影中的耦合效应两大挑战。该耦合体现在投影由局部手姿、手腕位置和相机内参共同决定。
method: 提出两项关键创新：Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision用于手部深度信息提取，Perspective Information Embedding用于解耦局部姿态与手腕位置，二者集成于主流encoder-decoder架构。此外，提出帧率感知的多数据集训练策略用于序列姿态细化。
result: 在HO3D数据集上，CS-MJE指标相比SOTA最多提升37.1%。
conclusion: 该框架有效解决了单目相机空间手部姿态估计中的深度模糊与耦合问题，在HO3D上取得显著提升，为相关研究提供了新思路。

title: DeCo: Efficient Decouple-to-Couple Learning for Multi-Task Visual Grounding
abstract: Multi-task visual grounding requires models to jointly understand linguistic semantics and perform accurate visual localization and segmentation. Despite the success of multimodal large language models, effectively adapting them to multiple grounding objectives remains challenging. Existing methods commonly enforce task cooperation through shared representations, while overlooking the intrinsic conflict between task-oriented feature interests. In this paper, we introduce $\textbf{DeCo}$, an efficient $\textbf{De}$couple-to-$\textbf{Co}$uple learning framework that resolves this dilemma through a two-stage paradigm: task-specific representation decoupling followed by complementary prior coupling. Specifically, we first propose Task-aware Semantic Decoupling (TSD) to route shared visual cues into individual features under salient word-level guidance, alleviating representation interference between localization and segmentation. Furthermore, we observe that segmentation naturally provides informative localization priors due to dense supervision. Based on this insight, we introduce Hybrid Prior Coupling (HPC), which integrates sentence-level semantic prior with mask-derived spatial prior for enhanced grounding. Built upon a frozen multimodal encoder, DeCo requires lightweight trainable parameters while achieving strong generalization across multiple grounding objectives. Extensive experiments on RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD, and RefDIOR demonstrate that DeCo achieves state-of-the-art performance on both natural and remote sensing benchmarks. The code and models are available at https://github.com/xiaoqiang-lu/DeCo.
tldr: DeCo提出解耦到耦合两阶段学习，以轻量参数实现多任务视觉定位SOTA。
motivation: 多任务视觉定位需同时理解语言语义并完成精确定位与分割，但现有多模态大模型方法依赖共享表示促进任务协作，忽视定位与分割之间的特征利益冲突，导致多目标适配困难。
method: DeCo采用两阶段范式：任务感知语义解耦（TSD）在显著词级引导下将共享视觉线索路由为任务专属特征，缓解定位与分割的表示干扰；混合先验耦合（HPC）融合句子级语义先验和掩码导出的空间先验以增强定位。整个框架基于冻结多模态编码器，仅需轻量可训练参数。
result: 在RefCOCO/+, G-Ref, ReferIt, Flickr, DIOR-RSVG, SARVG1.0, RRSIS-D, RIS-LAD和RefDIOR等自然与遥感基准上，DeCo均达到SOTA；摘要未提供具体量化指标，但强调其轻量训练参数与跨多目标强泛化能力。
conclusion: 实验表明解耦再耦合策略能有效解决多任务特征冲突，为多任务视觉定位提供高效且泛化性强的方案，并覆盖自然与遥感场景；代码和模型已开源。

title: AnalogDepth: Multi-view Geometry from FPV drones under Analog Video Transmission
abstract:
Analog video transmission (VTX) remains widespread in FPV drones due to low latency, weight and low cost. However analog VTX suffers from complex spatially structured image degradation which differ fundamentally from digital image corruption (e.g. AWGN) used in standard training augmentation. This work shows that this type of noise severely degrades the accuracy of Depth Anything 3 (DA3), a state-of-the-art feed forward visual geometry foundation model.
  To address this gap, we present AnalogDepth, a parameter-efficient training pipeline that adapts DA3 to analog FPV imagery using student-teacher knowledge distillation with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) injected into the DINOv2 backbone. Rather than synthesizing noise analytically, we build a noise bank from static FPV recordings under diverse conditions and compare real-noise injection against PSD-matched Gaussian synthesis and AWGN as baselines. Experiments on six real FPV flight sequences across three indoor scenes show that training with our noise bank consistently reduces per-frame depth RMSE and 3D reconstruction Chamfer distance compared to the pretrained DA3 baseline and both Gaussian noise variants. These results demonstrate that replicating the spatial structure of real analog transmission noise is critical for effective adaptation.
tldr: 提出AnalogDepth，用真实模拟图传噪声库结合LoRA蒸馏微调DA3，提升FPV无人机深度估计与三维重建精度。
motivation: 模拟视频传输（VTX）因低延迟、轻量、低成本在FPV无人机中仍被广泛使用，但其图像退化具有复杂空间结构，与数字图像中常用的AWGN等噪声增强存在本质差异。现有前馈视觉几何基础模型Depth Anything 3（DA3）在该类噪声下精度严重下降，而针对模拟噪声的适配方法尚属空白。
method: 提出参数高效的训练流程AnalogDepth，以学生-教师知识蒸馏为主干，并在DINOv2 backbone中注入LoRA对DA3进行适配。不使用解析式噪声合成，而是从多条件下静态FPV录像构建真实噪声库，并设置PSD匹配高斯合成与AWGN两种基线进行噪声注入对比。
result: 在三个室内场景的六段真实FPV飞行序列上，使用该噪声库训练相比预训练DA3基线及两种高斯噪声变体，一致地降低了逐帧深度RMSE与三维重建Chamfer距离；摘要未提供具体数值指标。
conclusion: 结果表明，复现真实模拟传输噪声的空间结构是有效域适配的关键，噪声库增强优于解析式高斯噪声合成；该工作为FPV模拟图传下的多视图几何与深度估计提供了参数高效的适配范式。

title: OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones
abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.
tldr: OpenFlyScan是面向消费级无人机的质量引导航拍重建系统，可预测重建缺陷并规划补采，低成本快速构建城市资产。
motivation: 3D Gaussian Splatting虽能提供高保真场景，但大规模城市资产构建受昂贵设备和延迟质量反馈限制；预设航拍常导致复杂表面观测不足，缺陷需重建后才发现，造成返工。
method: 系统集成GS质量模型、重采集规划器和定制移动App；质量模型从GS渲染误差学习预测区域重建质量，规划器据此生成互补补采航线，App执行并支持自动倾斜摄影与数据传输，无需额外机载硬件。
result: 在真实航拍场景中，模型能有效识别可能重建不佳区域；Expo West现场实验中，针对性补采使额外视角PSNR提升10.95 dB。
conclusion: OpenFlyScan证明消费级无人机可整合采集、针对性补采与重建，支持快速低成本城市资产创建；代码和模型将公开。

title: Colon3R: Cross-Domain 3D Reconstruction from Monocular Colonoscopic Video
abstract: Monocular colonoscopic 3D reconstruction is important for surgical robotic colonoscopy, but remains challenging due to weak texture, specular reflections, limited view overlap, and non-rigid tissue motion. Conventional multi-view 3D reconstruction methods rely on stable correspondences and approximate rigidity, which are often violated in colonoscopy. Existing endoscopic methods often rely on domain-specific supervision, whereas there are not enough in-vivo labeled data available to adapt geometry foundation models to clinical colonoscopy. We present Colon3R, a cross-domain semi-supervised framework built on pretrained VGGT that transfers coupled camera, depth, and pointmap geometry from labeled phantom and simulated data to unlabeled in-vivo colonoscopy without requiring target-domain geometric annotations. Unlike source-only fine-tuning, which learns only from phantom and simulated data, Colon3R directly exploits unlabeled in-vivo video through teacher-derived cross-view supervision. Our proposed hierarchical quasi-rigid reliability selects reliable supervision at the sequence, directed-pair, and pixel levels, while source-preserving adaptation retains the learned coupled geometry during target-domain adaptation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves superior overall performance over state-of-the-art approaches in depth, pointmap, and camera pose estimation. Qualitative comparisons on real in-vivo colonoscopy further show substantially more complete and geometrically consistent reconstructions than competing methods under clinical domain shift. The code will be public available after the paper is accepted.
tldr: Colon3R 提出跨域半监督框架，基于 VGGT 将标注体模与仿真数据的几何迁移至无标注活体结肠镜视频，实现更完整一致的 3D 重建。
motivation: 单目结肠镜三维重建对手术机器人结肠镜重要，但受弱纹理、镜面反射、视角重叠有限和非刚性组织运动影响；传统多视图方法依赖稳定对应与近似刚性假设，现有内窥镜方法依赖域内标注，而活体标注数据不足。
method: 基于预训练 VGGT 构建跨域半监督框架，利用教师模型生成的跨视图监督直接挖掘无标注活体视频；提出分层准刚性可靠性机制在序列、有向对和像素级筛选可靠监督，并用源域保持适配在目标域适配中保留已学到的耦合几何。
result: 大量实验表明，该方法在深度、点云图和相机位姿估计上总体优于现有最先进方法；真实活体结肠镜定性比较显示，在临床域偏移下重建更完整、几何更一致。
conclusion: Colon3R 无需目标域几何标注即可实现跨域 3D 重建，为临床结肠镜提供更鲁棒的几何基础模型适配方案，代码将在论文录用后公开。

title: SAM-V: Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation
abstract: Consistent multi-view object segmentation is critical for 3D perception and robotics, yet remains challenging under severe viewpoint and occlusion changes. Existing methods typically perform 3D instance segmentation on point clouds or rely on offline 2D mask-matching pipelines. However, 3D instance segmentation is limited by scarce 3D annotations, while offline 2D matching suffers from object identity ambiguity across frames. To leverage strong 2D and 3D priors jointly, we propose SAM-V (Geometry-Aware Segment Anything for Multi-View Instance Segmentation). Instead of combining the two priors through post-hoc matching, SAM-V directly integrates features from a feed-forward geometry model (VGGT) into a 2D segmentation foundation model (SAM), trained end-to-end for cross-view instance prediction. SAM-V introduces a prompt-fusion mechanism that enriches sparse SAM prompt tokens with view-specific camera tokens and local VGGT features, making the prompt representation both view-aware and spatially grounded, together with a mask decoder that attends to dense 2D and 3D features. By conditioning the mask decoding directly on multi-view geometry, SAM-V produces consistent multi-view segmentation of a prompted object in a single forward pass without offline mask matching or explicit 3D reconstruction. On the IGGT 3D tracking benchmark, where consistent instance identity across frames directly determines performance, SAM-V improves overall IoU by 5 points and frame-level recall by 12 points on the ScanNet++ split over the state-of-the-art multi-view instance segmentation baseline and leads on all metrics in the zero-shot ScanNet split. Our code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/gong208/SAM-V.git.
tldr: SAM-V将VGGT几何特征融入SAM提示与掩码解码，单次前向实现跨视角一致的实例分割。
motivation: 多视角一致的目标分割对3D感知与机器人至关重要，但大幅视角变化和遮挡使其依然困难。现有方法要么依赖标注稀缺的3D点云做实例分割，要么使用离线2D掩码匹配流水线，后者存在跨帧物体身份歧义问题。
method: SAM-V不再通过事后匹配融合2D与3D先验，而是将前馈几何模型VGGT的特征直接注入2D分割基础模型SAM，并进行端到端训练以完成跨视角实例预测。其提示融合机制用视角相关的相机token与局部VGGT特征增强稀疏SAM提示token，使提示兼具视角感知与空间定位能力；掩码解码器同时关注稠密2D与3D特征，直接以多视角几何为条件，无需离线掩码匹配或显式3D重建即可单次前向输出一致的多视角分割。
result: 在IGGT 3D跟踪基准上，SAM-V在ScanNet++划分上相比最先进的多视角实例分割基线整体IoU提升5个点、帧级召回提升12个点，并在零样本ScanNet划分上在所有指标上领先。
conclusion: 该工作证明将几何基础模型特征端到端融入2D分割基础模型，可在单次前向中实现几何一致的多视角实例分割，无需离线匹配或显式重建，为3D感知与机器人应用提供了新范式。代码与预训练模型已开源。

title: Estimating Accurate Hand Pose in Camera Space with Vision Transformer
abstract: Monocular RGB-based hand pose estimation has emerged as a critical research frontier in computer vision. The local hand pose estimation methods predict hand poses relative to the wrist, while global hand pose estimation also requires estimating the wrist's position in the camera coordinate system. However, this camera-space estimation confronts two fundamental challenges: (1) depth ambiguity in monocular settings, and (2) the coupling effect of hand local poses and global wrist positions in the perspective projections. In particular, this coupling reflects that the projections are jointly determined by local hand poses, wrist positions, and camera intrinsics. To overcome these challenges, our framework proposes two key innovations: Transformation-Isomorphism Supervision for hand-depth information extraction and Perspective Information Embedding for resolving above coupling effect of local pose and wrist position, both integrated within the mainstream encoder-decoder architecture. Besides, we propose a novel framerate-aware multi-dataset training strategy for sequential pose refinement.
